name: Bell Ogre
look: A towering grey-skinned ogre with a pot belly and huge arms, a tarnished bronze church bell on a beam as a maul in the RIGHT hand, iron chains wrapped round its waist and wrists, a tiny head with a jutting underbite and tusks.

idle.note: Standing at rest, slow breathing and a small weight shift; F6 flows back into F1.

walk.note: Walking loop in place (the game moves the sprite); F6 flows into F1.

run.note: Running loop in place, leaning into the run; F6 flows into F1.

jump.note: Jump. Keep the body near the ground line: the game lifts the sprite, the frames only change the pose.

smash.note: Overhead bell-maul smash; the bell tolls on impact. Slow heavy attack with a long, readable wind-up; damage lands on F5.

sweep.note: Wide sideways sweep of the maul. Melee attack; damage lands on F4.

ground_pound.note: Jumps and lands with both feet, shaking the ground (the game spawns a shockwave on F4). Leaping attack: the game moves the creature forward and up; damage lands on F4 as it comes down.

roar.note: Roar / taunt: head up, jaws wide on F3-F4.

hurt.note: Pain flinch: knocked back on F1-F2, recovers to the idle pose by F6.

death.note: Death: collapses onto the ground line. F6 is held, then swapped for the corpse, so F6 must match the corpse sheet in the same direction.
